why: An amendments array can be emptied as easily as a false claim can be written. These are the amendments an independent seat established from evidence outside this directory, so dropping one or quietly rewording its before/after is the exact failure the record exists to prevent. tools/verify.mjs A8 fails on either.
scope: Only evidence-established amendments are locked. The author's own marker-token note and the two unreconciled declaration/drawing divergences are recorded in registry.json but not locked, because nothing outside that file corroborates them; a later seat may add to the array freely, and may not remove or alter these.
evidence: Prior wordings recovered by the host from the authoring session's Claude transcript (the Edit event near line 1190 of 604c82de-9861-4d19-920e-8f69b2db575c.jsonl) and supplied to the audit session, which could not read that path itself. Corroborated against artefacts: each `after` string is byte-present in registry.json, each drawn band implements its `after` description and not its `before` one, and neither `before` string appears anywhere in this directory.
